mapper.select: SELECT DATE(create_time) as statDate, AVG( CASE emotion WHEN '满意' THEN 3.0 WHEN '一般' THEN 2.0 WHEN '不满' THEN 1.0 ELSE NULL END ) as avgScore, COUNT(*) as chatCount FROM chat_history WHERE create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time < #{endTime} AND emotion IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY statDate ASC
SELECT emotion, COUNT(*) as count FROM chat_history WHERE create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time < #{endTime} AND emotion IS NOT NULL GROUP BY emotion
